scenario.concurrencyModel: one server process per engine, pinned to one core of work: Proa one Tokio worker thread, Go GOMAXPROCS=1, Node single process
scenario.responseContract: every measured response is byte-identical to the engine's parity-gated canonical dump

methodology.protocol: HTTP/1.1 loopback with keep-alive and compression disabled
methodology.javascriptMode: production: NODE_ENV=production is set by the driver and confirmed by each JavaScript server's health endpoint; React also reports which react-dom server build it loaded
methodology.concurrencyModel: one server process per engine, pinned to one core of work: Proa one Tokio worker thread, Go GOMAXPROCS=1, Node single process
methodology.closedLoop: 64 concurrent connections issue requests back to back; throughput is completions inside the observation window
methodology.openLoop: fixed-rate arrivals at each workload's fixed rate; latency is measured from scheduled arrival
methodology.loadGenerator: 24 forked Bun worker processes share the schedule and hash every response
methodology.cpu: server process CPU-time delta across all threads divided by successful responses
methodology.memory: server RSS sampled with ps every 100 ms; peak is the largest sample
methodology.validation: every measured response is byte-identical to the engine's canonical adapter dump
methodology.processLifecycle: fresh production server process for every engine/workload/phase/repeat
